{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{one source|date=October 2022}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year=2022–23 |team=Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders |sport=Basketball |image=Middle Tennessee MT Logomark.svg |image_size=150 |conference=Conference USA |short_conf=CUSA |division= |record=19–14 |conf_record=11–9 |CoachRank= |APRank= |head_coach=[[Nick McDevitt]] |hc_year=5th |assoc_coach=Wes Long |asst_coach1=Logan Johnson |asst_coach2=Eric Wilson |asst_coach3= |stadium=[[Murphy Center]] |champion= |tourney= |tourney_result= }} {{2022–23 Conference USA men's basketball standings}} The '''2022–23 Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders men's basketball team''' represented [[Middle Tennessee State University]] during the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by fifth-year head coach [[Nick McDevitt]], and played their home games at [[Murphy Center]] in [[Murfreesboro, Tennessee]] as members of [[Conference USA]] (C-USA). == Previous season == The [[2021–22 Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders men's basketball team|Blue Raiders]] finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 26–11, 13–5 in C-USA play to finish to win the East Division. They defeated [[2021–22 UTEP Miners men's basketball team|UTEP]] in quarterfinals of the [[2022 Conference USA men's basketball tournament|C-USA tournament]] before losing to [[2021–22 UAB Blazers men's basketball team|UAB]] in the semifinals. They were invited to the [[2022 College Basketball Invitational|CBI]], where they defeated [[2021–22 California Baptist Lancers men's basketball team|California Baptist]], [[2021–22 Boston University Terriers men's basketball team|Boston University]] and [[2021–22 Abilene Christian Wildcats men's basketball team|Abilene Christian]] to advance to the championship game, where they lost to [[2021–22 UNC Wilmington Seahawks men's basketball team|UNC Wilmington]]. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
